description: Migrate the call-routing and IVR (Interactive Voice Response) configuration from a legacy PBX to a new cloud-based contact center platform. The routing table has 500 rules (DID → queue → agent group → IVR menu). The migration must follow: dial-plan rework (map legacy dial patterns to the new platform's routing model), configure the new routing table (import rules, set up queues, IVR menus, business-hours/after-hours logic), test routes (place test calls through each major routing path — DID, extension dial, IVR menu traversal, queue overflow), execute cutover (switch inbound DIDs to the new platform), and monitor (call answer rate, IVR completion rate, queue wait time). A rollback plan must exist (re-route DIDs back to the legacy PBX). Risk factors: routing rule edge cases (holiday schedules, overflow chains), IVR voice prompt mismatches, and call quality differences. Tools available: cloud contact center platform (Genesys/Twilio/Amazon Connect), SIP trunk, Wireshark, monitoring dashboards, CSV import/export for routing rules.
